title: Senior Integrations Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small engineering team building the backend and integrations behind a logistics decision-intelligence platform for temperature-sensitive and high-value shipments. You will own data-heavy systems that turn partner and IoT data into reliable shipment visibility and timely risk insights.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build backend services and distributed systems for logistics orchestration and shipment risk analysis.

 - Own end-to-end partner data flows, from integrating and normalizing multi-vendor and IoT data through warehousing, monitoring, and operational support.

 - Develop event-driven services and predictive workflows that support shipment risk assessment, on-time and in-full performance, and exception handling.

 - Build and maintain partner-facing APIs, webhooks, queues, and other external integrations.

 - Improve the reliability and scalability of services through testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of backend engineering experience building scalable, distributed production systems, with roughly 6 to 10 years preferred.

 - Hands-on proficiency in Python and TypeScript or Node.js, plus SQL, relational data modeling, and experience with NoSQL databases and ETL pipelines.

 - Experience with IoT data ingestion and contextualization, partner APIs, event-driven architectures, and messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

 - Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, REST or gRPC APIs, and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Strong production ownership, including deployment, on-call support, security considerations, and service observability.

 - Ability to work independently as a senior individual contributor; logistics, supply chain, cold-chain, or regulated healthcare experience is a plus.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $130,000 to $160,000 annually, plus equity and a cash bonus. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

Remote within the United States.

title: Founding Harness Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI team to build the agent runtime and evaluation systems that help an AI coworker act reliably in real team workflows. You will shape when agents take initiative, request approval, or stay quiet.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build the agent runtime for providing context, selecting tools, requesting approvals, and completing work.

 - Write and refine system prompts to make agent behavior proactive without becoming noisy or unsafe.

 - Build evaluation and regression tests for real tasks, tool use, and failure cases.

 - Improve reliability across long-running tasks, interruptions, and retries.

 - Implement safeguards such as approval gates and multi-tenant data separation.

 - Work directly with the founding team and early users to take broad problems from prototype to production.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Production experience shipping tool-using LLM agents, beyond demos or thin prompt wrappers.

 - Hands-on system prompt design, improved through testing and iteration.

 - Experience building evaluation and regression test harnesses for LLM or agent behavior.

 - Understanding of safe tool execution, approval workflows, and multi-user data risks.

 - Strong ownership of broad technical problems and the ability to explain tradeoffs.

 - Experience with LLM agents, tool use, evaluations, and prompt engineering.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Founding equity is offered; the percentage and vesting terms are to be confirmed.


LOCATION

Remote, from Serbia, Poland, or another Eastern European country. Local employment or contractor structure and working-hour overlap are to be confirmed.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Own the product experience and platform for an AI-powered renewable energy diligence service. You will work directly with customers and expert reviewers to build and ship tools that help accelerate financing and development of energy infrastructure projects.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Talk with customers and translate their needs into product improvements.

 - Design, build, and ship features across the customer, analyst, and expert reviewer experience.

 - Develop and operate the platform supporting AI-assisted document review and diligence workflows.

 - Build systems that keep customer data isolated, access-controlled, and auditable.

 - Ensure extracted claims are grounded in source documents, and route unsupported questions to expert reviewers.

 - Use measurable experiments to evaluate changes, monitor accuracy, and address regressions.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two or more years of experience, with startup experience as a founding engineer or an early team member.

 - Full-stack engineering experience across frontend and backend development.

 - Experience with agent architectures or LLM-powered workflows.

 - Experience building document processing, retrieval, or extraction systems.

 - Familiarity with Rails, React, Postgres, or Elasticsearch.

 - Background in fintech, legaltech, proptech, or energy and infrastructure.

 - Ability to work in North American time zones.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $130,000 to $150,000 USD annually, with meaningful equity. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Remote, with a primary location in Canada.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a B2B AI communications SaaS team as a Senior Fullstack Engineer, building voice AI products for businesses. You will own customer-facing features from concept through deployment and help shape the product roadmap.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and evolve full-stack product features using NestJS, TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

 - Take features from discovery and prototyping through production release.

 - Engage with customers through support, feedback sessions, and user testing to understand their needs.

 - Prioritize and scope work around immediate customer value, then iterate based on feedback.

 - Contribute to feature prioritization and product roadmap decisions.

 - Ship improvements frequently while maintaining focus on reliable, customer-facing software.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of full-stack engineering experience building and delivering SaaS products.

 - Strong hands-on experience across both backend and frontend engineering, including TypeScript, React, and Node.js; NestJS experience is preferred.

 - Experience owning end-to-end features, from technical and product decisions through deployment.

 - Experience working directly with customers and using feedback, experiments, and metrics to inform product decisions.

 - Native German proficiency and fluent English.

 - Experience with AI or LLM integrations, fast-moving product teams, or European AI and data privacy considerations is useful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Annual base salary: €80,000 to €120,000. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Remote within Germany.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Database Observability, Grafana Cloud | Spain | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Spain and Germany.
About Grafana Cloud Observability
Grafana Cloud is our fully managed observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to use the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.
Within the Observability department, we build products that help customers understand and troubleshoot their applications and infrastructure. We work closely with product management, design and other engineering squads to provide seamless and highly curated experiences for our customers.
The squad: Database Observability
We build and evolve Grafana Cloud Database Observability. We want to help users understand the health and performance of their databases, identify slow queries and troubleshoot issues through clear, actionable insights.
As a frontend engineer on the squad, you’ll build experiences that make complex database telemetry easy to explore and understand. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product management and design to take ideas from early exploration through to production and improve them based on customer feedback.
Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. Your primary focus will be frontend engineering, with opportunities to work across the stack, contributing to APIs and backend functionality to deliver complete customer experiences. Frontend engineers at Grafana also have opportunities to contribute to open source communities.
The opportunity:
• Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout, including getting user feedback and measuring whether what you shipped actually worked.
• Collaborate with Product Management, Product Design and backend engineers to build intuitive user experiences using clean, reusable components, contributing to supporting APIs and backend functionality where needed.
• Mentor and collaborate with other engineers. Raise the engineering bar through code review, design feedback, pairing on hard problems, and writing that leaves the team better than you found it.
• Participate in on-call for the software you help build, contributing to incident response and learning from incidents.
• Provide technical support in customer escalations and help us identify areas of high friction to address.
• Collaborate with other squads on shared dependencies, contribute to design proposals, and share the team’s work through demos and technical discussions.
We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
What makes you a great fit:
• We highly value those who are intellectually curious , who default to transparency , possess a high bias towards action , and who are also kind and enjoy working as a team .
• Strong frontend engineering experience, with experience across the stack. You have experience building and maintaining production web applications with React and TypeScript, and are comfortable contributing to backend services and APIs. You value maintainability, readability, automated testing and secure development practices.
• Technical ownership. You have solid experience delivering complex projects, mentoring other engineers and helping teammates work more effectively. You communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.
• You take responsibility for operating the software you have built . You have experience being on-call, supporting software in production, ensuring reliability and responding to incidents as needed.
• You enjoy working on complex solutions , building production software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
• User focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.
• AI experience with a practical mindset. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and quality, validate their output, and share useful practices

title: Director of Technology Partnerships
locationText: Remote, San Francisco, CA, US | United States
locationReason: remote role listed per country; description says it hires globally
locationEvidence: chnology ecosystem. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Director of Technology Partnerships to lead the teams responsible for growing Supabase through technology integrations and our marketplace ecosystem.

You’ll bring together two complementary motions: partnerships that embed Supabase into the products developers already use, and a marketplace that helps developers discover and connect complementary technologies to their Supabase projects. Your job is to turn both into durable sources of revenue, adoption, and customer value.

Reporting to the Head of Partnerships, you’ll lead and develop the Integrations and Marketplace teams, set their commercial strategy, and work hands-on with our most important partners. A central part of the role is working closely with AI labs to build strategic relationships, develop integrations, and bring joint opportunities to market. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to take integrations from idea to launch—and grow their impact long after launch.

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, where you’ll build relationships with leading AI, developer tools, and infrastructure companies. Supabase is remote-first, and you’ll work across a globally distributed team.



RESPONSIBILITIES


LEAD THE TEAM AND STRATEGY

 - Lead, coach, and develop the Integrations and Marketplace partnerships teams, including team leads and partner managers.

 - Set a clear strategy for where Supabase invests across strategic technology partnerships, marketplace categories, and emerging ecosystem opportunities.

 - Define team objectives, partner coverage, investment priorities, and operating cadence. Make thoughtful tradeoffs between high-touch strategic partnerships and scalable programs.

 - Build a culture of ownership, commercial discipline, and strong cross-functional execution.


GROW REVENUE THROUGH TECHNOLOGY PARTNERSHIPS

 - Drive revenue from technology integrations through partner-driven customer acquisition, product consumption, expansion, retention, co-sell opportunities, and commercial arrangements.

 - Own the commercial performance of the technology partnerships and marketplace portfolio, including forecasting and reporting on progress, risks, and return on investment.

 - Build and deepen relationships with AI labs, working closely with their product, engineering, business development, and executive teams to identify and execute high-impact partnership opportunities.

 - Develop executive relationships with strategic partners across developer tools, cloud, and adjacent infrastructure.

 - Lead or support negotiations for complex partnerships, including integration, referral, revenue-sharing, and joint go-to-market agreements.

 - Help partner managers build joint business plans that connect partner priorities to measurable outcomes for Supabase and its customers.


LEAD THE MARKETPLACE TEAM

 - Lead and develop the Marketplace team, setting its commercial and partner strategy and holding the team accountable for outcomes.

 - Guide the team in identifying the capabilities developers need, recruiting the right partners, and helping those partners launch and grow.

 - Set priorities and allocate resources across strategic, high-touch partners and scalable paths for emerging and self-serve partners.

 - Ensure the team works effectively with Product and Engineering on integration quality, partner onboarding, discovery, activation, and the developer experience across product surfaces.

 - Enable the team to work with Marketing and Sales to launch integrations, enable teams, and drive ongoing adoption—not just announcements.


OPERATE WITH RIGOR

 - Establish clear measures for partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, integration adoption, revenue, consumption, retention, and marketplace performance.

 - Work with Finance, Data, and Partner Operations to improve attribution, reporting, forecasting, and partner revenue processes.

 - Represent the voice of partners and customers in product and go-to-market planning, while aligning stakeholders around shared priorities.

 - Identify risks early, remove blockers, and communicate decisions and outcomes clearly to leadership.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Have significant experience in technology partnerships, business development, or ecosystem leadership at a developer tools, cloud, infrastructure, or SaaS company.

 - Have led and developed partner-facing teams, including managers or senior individual contributors, and can balance strategic direction with hands-on execution.

 - Have a track record of building partnerships that produced measurable revenue, product adoption, or customer growth.

 - Have negotiated complex commercial agreements and understand partnership economics, including revenue share, referrals, and consumption-based models.

 - Have worked closely with Product and Engineering to ship and grow technical integrations. You can engage credibly with technical teams, including those at AI labs, even if you aren’t the person writing the code.

 - Know how to build relationships with executives while earning the trust of product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.

 - Use data to prioritize opportunities, assess partner performance, and make decisions when attribution is imperfect.

 - Are comfortable building in an evolving environment, communicating in writing, and working asynchronously across time zones.


IT’S A PLUS IF YOU HAVE

 - Built or scaled a developer marketplace, integration ecosystem, or partner platform.

 - Worked with AI LLMs, AI app builders, databases, open-source products, or developer infrastructure.

 - A background in software development, with an understanding of how developers build

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python) - AI
locationText: Remote - Europe Time Zones | Portugal | Spain | Poland
description:
SplitMetrics is a global software company offering an ecosystem of products and services that serve as a growth engine for top mobile-first businesses worldwide. Our ecosystem includes:

 - SplitMetrics Acquire, a platform for automating and optimizing Apple Ads. 

 - SplitMetrics Agency, a full-service mobile marketing agency staffed by top experts.

 - SplitMetrics Optimize, an A/B testing platform recognized as the ASO Tool of the Year.

 - App Radar by SplitMetrics: an ASO platform with advanced keyword and competitor insights.


WHY SPLITMETRICS? 

 - For over 11 years, we’ve been at the forefront of the mobile marketing industry, building an ecosystem of market-leading technologies.

 - An Apple Ads Partner, SplitMetrics is the 1st company to build the Apple Ads management platform. 

 - Working with top mobile companies and brands globally: Skyscanner, Glovo, Flo, Babbel, Wooga and many more.

 - Generating an impressive transaction volume, with over $1 billion in ad spend flowing through our ecosystem.

 - Integrated AI into our strategic approach since 2023.

 - Effectively collaborate across 20+ countries with a remote-first and supportive culture.



We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python) who will join our team.



What will you do:

 - Design and build backend services in Python (FastAPI)

 - Implement async job execution and status tracking (Redis/Celery/Kafka)

 - Integrate with LLM services (internal & external)

The role
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Developer to support the migration of an enterprise digital platform from Sitecore to Contentful.
The role involves both content migration and the migration of existing applications, React/Typescript development, API integrations and modern headless architectures.
We are also looking for someone with an AI-first mindset who embraces AI-assisted and spec-driven development to improve delivery speed, quality and consistency, while retaining ownership of technical judgement and code quality.

Application and Content Migration

• Develop content migration tooling, scripts and automated transformation processes.
• Implement Contentful content models, API integrations and content delivery patterns.
• Ensure migrated applications maintain functionality, performance, accessibility and quality.
AI-Native Engineering
• Adopt an AI-first mindset, proactively identifying opportunities to accelerate development, migration and problem-solving using AI.

• Use AI coding assistants effectively while reviewing, testing and taking accountability for generated outputs.
• Share AI-enabled development practices and contribute to improving team productivity.
Engineering Quality and Collaboration
• Independently own complex development tasks and significant migration components.
• Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and contribute to CI/CD and automated testing.
• Identify technical risks, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.
• Collaborate with Lead Developers, architects, QA and content teams.
• Support less experienced developers through mentoring, code reviews and knowledge sharing.
Essential Skills and Experience
• Strong commercial software engineering experience, particularly with React and TypeScript .
• Experience migrating, modernising or refactoring existing frontend applications.
• Practical experience with headless CMS platforms, preferably Contentful, and an understanding of Sitecore.
• Strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns and content modelling.
• Experience with backend development, migration scripting or data transformation.
• Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of spec-driven development approaches.
• Experience with automated testing, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
• Ability to work independently, solve complex problems and influence technical implementation decisions.
Desirable Experience
• Direct experience migrating Sitecore applications and content to Contentful.
• Experience with Next.js, Sitecore JSS or CMS/DXP replatforming.
• Experience applying AI to content analysis, migration automation, code transformation or test generation.
• Experience with multilingual, multisite or composable digital platforms.
If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.
Commitment to reaching all kinds of people
We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
The benefits
This is a Permanent position based in Portugal .
Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training, and industry experts
Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Austin, TX | San Francisco, CA | Lisbon, Portugal
About the Department
Cloudflare's Enterprise Integrations Engineering Team designs, builds, and maintains integrations across the SaaS applications used throughout the organization. We're increasingly applying AI, from agentic workflows to LLM-assisted development and automated diagnostics, to build integrations faster, operate them more reliably, and reduce manual toil across the team. Our mission is to create scalable, reliable, and intelligent systems that ensure data flows securely and efficiently between platforms, and to use AI as a force multiplier for how we design, build, and support that work.
Our team is highly collaborative, values continuous learning, and supports each other through shared ownership and open communication. We work closely with both technical and business teams, conduct regular retrospectives, and are actively evolving how AI tooling changes the way we plan, build, test, and troubleshoot integrations.
What You’ll Do
We’re looking for a Principal Engineer to establish technical direction across Enterprise Applications and help teams turn that direction into reliable, incremental delivery. You’ll design systems, lead complex cross-team initiatives, influence engineering practices, and remain hands-on with implementation where your contribution has the greatest leverage.
This role requires navigating ambiguity, adapting technical strategy as conditions change, and building alignment across engineering and business stakeholders. You’ll model responsible AI-assisted engineering, operational excellence, sound judgment, and attention to detail.
Responsibilities include:
• Establish and communicate technical strategy across multiple teams, translating long-term direction into incremental delivery plans.
• Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through architecture, implementation, deployment, and operation.
• Influence technical decisions across teams through design reviews, prototypes, standards, mentoring, and hands-on contributions.
• Build and extend AI-enabled systems, including agents, evaluation frameworks, MCP servers, and workflow automation.
• Determine when AI is appropriate and when deterministic software offers a safer, simpler, or more reliable solution.
• Establish practices for evaluating AI systems, including quality, reliability, security, cost, latency, and human oversight.
• Improve engineering effectiveness through reusable platforms, operational tooling, automated diagnostics, and development workflows.
• Partner with business and technical stakeholders to convert ambiguous problems into clear technical strategies and measurable outcomes.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience
• 10+ years of professional software engineering experience as a guideline
• Proficiency in at least one backend language.
• Experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.)
• Experience with AI guardrails/governance best practices
• Demonstrated experience delivering AI-enabled systems beyond experimentation. Candidates should be able to explain their individual contribution, evaluation approach, production constraints, failure modes, and measurable outcomes.
• Demonstrated experience influencing technical culture and best practices without authority.
• Familiarity with integration patterns (pub/sub, API-first, CDM, batch processing)
• Experience working with stakeholders to solve business problems through integration or automation solutions
• Experience building APIs with proper security and operational practices
• Experience with observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry, Kibana, Splunk or similar)
• Working familiarity with containerized/cloud environments (Kubernetes, or equivalent cloud-native experience)
• Experience with serverless computing platforms (e.g. AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, Azure Functions, or Cloudflare Workers)
• Experience with GitLab or other CI/CD tooling
• Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for roughly one week every two months
Bonus Points:

If you've ever been jolted awake at 2 AM, frustrated with Grafana, Datadog, or Elastic for not delivering the answers you need, you’ll resonate with the problem we’re solving. You'll unlock groundbreaking analysis tools that empower engineers to crack production issues like never before—all while scaling our cloud-hosted platform to deliver seamless, next-level performance for our growing customer base.
